checks.name: Actual MP copy aliases the existing player API and stays silent outside a battle
Actual player shuffles all39 bundled songs and avoids an immediate cycle repeat
OFF/ON persists through the private bridge without skipping the selected song
Activity and document background pause retain and resume one decoded song
Game exit aborts pending media and stale fetch/end callbacks cannot restart playback
Invalid playlist families, remote tracks and incomplete pools fail closed
Media failure is nonfatal and only explicit ON retries
MP copy cannot access the main bridge or fetch/extract the complete115MB archive
MP native config disables duplicate stock music while retaining effects and voice volumes

scope: Actual generated MP player with deterministic fetch/Audio/settings fixtures. Actual decoder is a separate optional browser check.
